notes: 1.0.0: vml -- observability, phase 1 (the owner, 2026-11-26): VictoriaMetrics and VictoriaLogs (static Go builds; VictoriaLogs takes the box's syslog forwarding itself), and vml-collector, the hibr catalogue's poller of the Cix API, which needs hibr. Replaces syslog-1 and syslog-2. Grafana follows in a later version once its build is settled. hibr is also the console. No bash, no coreutils. Rolling throughout.
